steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: seed-items-and-open-plan
steps.eval: (function(){const s=window.__store.getState(); s.setFloorPlanEditing(true); s.setItems([]); const rooms=s.floorPlan.rooms; const room=rooms.reduce((a,b)=>(b.width*b.depth>a.width*a.depth?b:a),rooms[0]); const ids=[]; for(let i=0;i<3;i++){ const x=room.origin[0]+0.8+i*0.4; const z=room.origin[1]+0.8+i*1.4; const id=s.addItem({defId:'potted-plant', position:[x,z], rotation:0, props:{}}); ids.push(id);} window.__alignIds=ids; s.setSelectedItemIds(ids); })()

steps.name: click-align-x
steps.eval: (function(){const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-props button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Align X'); if(!b) throw new Error('no Align X button'); b.click();})()

steps.name: click-distribute-z
steps.eval: (function(){const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-props button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Across Z'); if(!b) throw new Error('no Across Z button'); b.click();})()

waitFor.store: (function(){const its=[...window.__store.getState().items].sort((a,b)=>a.position[1]-b.position[1]); const g1=its[1].position[1]-its[0].position[1]; const g2=its[2].position[1]-its[1].position[1]; return Math.abs(g1-g2)<1e-4;})()

steps.name: record-mirror-before
steps.eval: (function(){const its=window.__store.getState().items; const xs=its.map(i=>i.position[0]); window.__cx = xs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/xs.length; window.__mb = its.map(i=>i.position[0]);})()
